description: Search the Stunt Double Index for sites by domain or name, or browse the leaderboard. Results are ordered by overall score, highest first, with rank, sector and when each was last scored; sites the Index could not score come last with a null score and an unscored_reason. Omit query to read the top of the leaderboard; add sector to compare a site against its peers. Follow up with get_index_report for the full breakdown of any result.

query.description: Part of a domain or site name, matched case-insensitively, e.g. "shop" or "stripe.com". Omit to browse the leaderboard from the top.

sector.description: Only sites in this sector, e.g. "saas". Omit for every sector.

name: search_index_domains

band.description: excellent, good, ok, poor or critical. Null when unscored.

domain.description: Pass this to get_index_report as domain.

report_url.description: The public Index report page for the site, to link a person to.

unscored_reason.description: Why the site has no score: blocked, unreachable, opted_out or pending. Null when it is scored.

title: Search Index domains
